run_batch_inference: run batch text generation on multiple prompts using the ChameleonInferenceModel
generate_batch_tokens: generate tokens from a batch of text prompts using ChameleonInferenceModel.generate
decode_batch_tokens: decode a batch of generated tokens back into text using ChameleonInferenceModel.decode_text
init_chameleon_model: initialize a ChameleonInferenceModel with model weights, text tokenizer, and VQ-GAN paths
run_main_example: run the main function to demonstrate batch inference with two sample prompts
